SPELL_ABILITY.TARGET_DEFINITION: local filter = ClearFilter() local subfilter = filter:AddSubFilter_Or() subfilter:Add( FE_TYPE, OP_IS, CARD_TYPE_ARTIFACT ) subfilter:Add( FE_TYPE, OP_IS, CARD_TYPE_CREATURE) subfilter:Add( FE_TYPE, OP_IS, CARD_TYPE_ENCHANTMENT )
SPELL_ABILITY.RESOLUTION_TIME_ACTION: local target = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0):Get_CardPtr(0) if target ~= nil then target:PutOnBottomOfLibrary() end

TRIGGERED_ABILITY.TRIGGER: local interrogation = MTG():ClearInterrogationQuery() interrogation:SetPlayer( EffectController() ) local num_drawn_this_turn = interrogation:Count( INTERROGATE_CARDS_DRAWN, INTERROGATE_THIS_TURN, 2 ) if num_drawn_this_turn == 1 then return true else return false end
TRIGGERED_ABILITY.RESOLUTION_TIME_ACTION: local effectController = EffectController() if TriggerObject()~= nil then if effectController:CanCastSpellUsingResourceCost( TriggerObject(), 1 ) then effectController:BeginNewMultipleChoice() effectController:AddMultipleChoiceAnswer( "CARD_QUERY_BANISHING_STROKE_CAST_BANISHING_STROKE" ) effectController:AddMultipleChoiceAnswer( "CARD_QUERY_BANISHING_STROKE_DO_NOT_CAST_BANISHING_STROKE" ) effectController:AskMultipleChoiceQuestion( "CARD_QUERY_BANISHING_STROKE_QUESTION", TriggerObject() ) end end

local answer = EffectController():GetMultipleChoiceResult() if TriggerObject() ~= nil and EffectController():CanCastSpellUsingResourceCost( TriggerObject(), 1 )then if answer == 0 then EffectController():CastSpellUsingResourceCost( TriggerObject(), 1 ) end end
